Select distinct compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for molecules tested against target CHEMBL2971. Join target_dictionary to assays on tid, assays to activities on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter where assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
